items.title: General Motors (GM) Restarts Ohio Battery Production After Seven Month Shutdown
items.summary: Ultium Cells, the General Motors (NYSE:GM) and LG Energy Solution joint venture, restarted battery production at its Warren, Ohio plant after a seven month shutdown linked to changes in US BEV market conditions and policy. The Warren facility return to operations marks a fresh step in rebuilding GM's domestic EV battery supply chain following the extended pause.
